integrity: Exact all-parameter counting proof, direct Walsh Gram characteristic-polynomial enumeration at m=2 and independent symplectic enumeration at m=2,3; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four erased positions in the hyperbolic quadratic Boolean harmonic Parseval frames, for m>=2; no general bent functions or higher erasures. Earlier work already established the 60 regular four-simplices at m=2.
title: Four-erasure trichotomy for quadratic-bent harmonic frames
